# NY Nightlife (nynightlife.com)

> Decide your NYC night in 5 minutes. Verified, dated facts about New York City nightlife: cover charges, dress codes, door policies, hours, and what tonight actually costs. Every venue fact carries a "Last verified" date and sources; unverifiable claims are marked as reported or unverified.

## Live pages (refreshed daily/weekly)
- [Tonight in NYC](https://nynightlife.com/tonight/): real ticketable events tonight, weather-aware, refreshed daily
- [This weekend](https://nynightlife.com/weekend/nyc-nightlife-this-weekend.html): real events with real prices, refreshed every Thursday
